subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add shared group pairing admission, and should pending read-only observation be part of that contract or a separate mode?
rationale: This changes group authorization state, owner notification routing, approval authority, and whether untrusted shared-room content may reach an agent before approval, which cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Design Shared Admission First
options.body: Create one cross-channel approval contract with persistence, owner notification, approve/reject authority, and explicit isolation rules before channel-specific implementation.

options.title: Ship Channel-Specific Mitigations Only
options.body: Let narrower Telegram/WhatsApp warn, leave, audit, and pairing-hook work proceed while deferring owner-notified group pairing.

options.title: Keep Allowlists Only
options.body: Reject group pairing for now and document group allowlists, disabled policy, mention gating, and sandboxed sessions as the supported posture.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Admission First
recommendation.body: Create one cross-channel approval contract with persistence, owner notification, approve/reject authority, and explicit isolation rules before channel-specific implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history and prior review context connect this owner most strongly to the security/config boundary decision.
